notes.title: Weekly Update #5 (v1.0.3.0) - Single Boostbar | Items Search | Manual Respawn
notes.notes:
What’s New This Week?
This week brings a bunch of exciting improvements to the game! 


Preset Customization: Item Search & Sorting Support
One of the most requested features is finally here - and it works great!

Sort items by: Oldest / Recent / Alphabetical / Popular

Search support: No more scrolling item by item to find the perfect character – now you can just search!
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43439860/0303b5296bed14891c62d900db5640f2434d3dc1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43439860/c39cd5b2c015994af88806d6a0593c193ed2bfe4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43439860/a6f11dc2a89f8699e3d55545f62de96ed7229843.png"][/carousel]

New Single Boost Bar UI
We’ve added two new versions of a single boost bar:

Long and short variations available

Includes small indicators for early / good / perfect boost (up to 3 in a row)

Fixed reserve text scaling issue

Minor polish and improvements

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43439860/4ce0f9cbf2cb6b6808f5c154a2ad1ec14f1feb38.png"]
New Settings & Accessibility Options
Option to disable player-to-player bounce physics

Accessibility setup (Auto Accel & Steer Assist) is now moved to the main Settings window

Accessibility options are now enabled in all game modes


Manual Respawn Support
Hold your respawn key for 1 second to trigger a manual respawn

PC: R

Xbox: Y

PlayStation: Triangle

Option to rebind the respawn key

A shorter, consistent respawn time is coming in the next update


What’s Coming Next?
Thanks so much for your continued support! We’re working hard on even more updates in the coming weeks.

The roadmap at tk2.nolt.io will be updated in the next few days

We’ll also be hosting an official The Karters 2 stream to talk with the community, set priorities, and plan the upcoming dev focus. Stay tuned for more info soon ( hopefully Monday -  September 22th)


Future Plans
We’re preparing some major updates, along with game promotions to bring in new players - so stay tuned! And if you haven’t already, please consider leaving a review - it really helps us out!


Console Port News
We’ve officially started working on console versions of the game!


There’s still a long road ahead, but optimization and a Steam Deck pass will be our next big focus as well – aiming to make the experience perfect on both Deck and consoles.



Thanks again – and see you next week! 👋

notes.title: Weekly Update #2 (v1.0.2.7) - Boostbar Perfect Info, Steam Screenshot Browser!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  

While we didn’t quite finish some of the bigger features this week (like new region-less matchmaking),  but we did roll out several quality-of-life improvements to make the experience smoother and more enjoyable :)


Center BoostBar – 'Perfect' Indicator & More
This may look like a small addition, but it can really improve how eryone understand and use the BoostBar.   

Now, after performing a boost, you’ll see clear feedback text: Early/ Great/Perfect 



Getting a Perfect means you’re achieving between 90%–100% of the possible reserves



Other BoostBar improvements:

 Reserves number now turns red when hitting an obstacle (community idea - we loved it!)

 Added option to adjust the Y position of the middle BoostBar.  

 Renamed "Width" → now called X position.  

 Added Mirrored Side option for the middle BoostBar.  

 Added Always Visible option for the middle BoostBar.  

 Added Lock Side option for the middle BoostBar.  

 Ability to choose only the middle, only the right, or both BoostBars at once.  

 Enabled live preview of the middle BoostBar while adjusting options.  

 Middle BoostBar now uses a gradient instead of a solid red color.  


ps. we also improved settings with clearer categories  like , Gameplay → BoostBars, Video → Effects.   


Steam Photo Browsing & Screenshot Upload
 From now on, when you enter the in-game gallery you’ll see Steam community screenshots sorted by:  

- Best of the past week   

- All-time favorites   

- Most recent    

Each screenshot also displays upvotes and the creator’s name.    



We’re exploring ways to allow in-game voting as well, though that will take more time.    

In addition, local screenshots can now be uploaded directly to Steam with a single click!    



We hope this makes the gallery more active and fun,  and we plan to expand it further in the future.

    
That’s all for now! ːsteamthumbsupː
We hope you enjoy these updates!   

Please restart Steam and stay tuned for next week’s update!

notes.title: Weekly Update #1 (v1.0.2.6) - Center boost bars! In-game photo mode & more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We’ve got some exciting stuff to share in today’s update - new team members, fresh features, and a bunch of improvements across the board!

🗓️ Weekly Updates
From now on, you can expect weekly updates - every Saturday,with either bigger or smaller improvements, depending on the week.

🎉 New team members
Let’s kick off with a warm welcome and some exciting news for the community and the game: we’ve got four amazing new full-time team members!

Jeremi & Jakub - Programming
First up, welcome Jeremi & Jakub – two programmers who’ve joined to help push the game forward faster than ever.
That means Sboczek is no longer coding solo, and he’s super happy to have their support!

Kami - Marketing & Community Manager
Next, let’s give a huge shoutout to Kami, who joined us full-time as Community & Marketing Manager last week!
He’s been with us for a while already - creating all the awesome videos you’ve seen, including the epic launch trailer and the live reaction video at the end of this update 🎬

Kami is also the heart of our Discord community, where he’s always connecting with players, collecting feedback, and keeping the good vibes going.
👉 discord.gg/thekarters

Matt - 2D Artist
And finally, we’re thrilled to welcome Matt, who’s joining the team part-time as a 2D Artist!
His story is especially awesome - he started out as a super active community member, and now he’s officially part of the dev team. We’re so happy to have him on board!

We’re beyond excited to have all four of them on board ❤️

New Programmers - What Are They Working On?
This collaboration is already going great - and two of the new features in this update were actually created by them:

 Jeremi worked on the in-game center boost bars , Amazing UI Design is made by Matt!
 Jakub handled the new in-game Photo Mode and Main Menu Photo Browser v1

What’s New in the Game?

You can catch all of these changes in action - with live reactions - from Kami, our community manager!

[previewyoutube=0MguLWYVYYA;full][/previewyoutube]

Center Boost Bars
New center boost bars are in! There are 4 different styles, and each comes in both long and short versions.
You can also tweak the X position and scale to your liking!

In-Game Photo Mode + Gallery
You’ve asked for it, and now it’s here: You can now take photos during gameplay - no need to go into replay mode anymore!

But we didn’t stop there...
The old Replay Viewer button has been replaced by a new Gallery button.
From there, you can:

 View replays like before
 Browse all your epic screenshots taken in Photo Mode (v1)

We’ll keep improving the gallery UI and fix any issues as we go.

Grand Prix - Track Order Selection
Now you can choose the exact track order in Grand Prix mode!
Just click a track to add it to the cup, and click again to remove it.

➡️ You don’t need to select every track - if you choose, say, 8 tracks in a 16-race cup and hit Done, the remaining ones will be filled in randomly.

Other Fixes & Tweaks


 Scuba Driving - The stones that allowed for the jump have been replaced with a box — making the jump more reliable.
 Beach Blast - Navigation pathing has been updated, so Tank item usage and respawning should now work as expected.
 Track Of The Day Colors- Cup colors for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in Track of the Day now display correctly!


Known Issues

 🐛 UI element partially covers Photo Mode toggle in Time Trial.
 🐛 Photos taken without enabling ultrawide aspect stretch the 16:9 preview in Gallery.
 🐛 Incorrect track names in Gallery previews.
 🐛 Cannot disable AI in a Time Trial Grand Prix.

🎵 OST Release 
And for all the music lovers out there -  yes, the OST release is on the horizon... 👀
Stay tuned, it may be dropping sooner than you think 🎧🔥

---

Leave a like if you’re enjoying the update, and don’t forget to drop a warm welcome to our new team members – they’re already doing amazing work! !

:fire: see you next week!

notes.title: Update v1.0.2.5 - 80 SP Challenges, ELO Revamp & 1st Achievement!
notes.notes:
Hey! 

I’m excited to announce that the latest update is live!
This release brings 80 brand-new challenges spread across every racetrack and game mode, replacing 20 older ones with fresh, more exciting goals to test your skills.


🚀improved ELO Scoring

 The ELO system now takes rank differences into account more heavily.
High-ranked players racing against lower ranks will need top positions to gain points -no more easy climbs just for being in the top 4!
 Because of this change, ELO scores were clamped to 5000 (instead of reset completely). If you had 8000 before, it’s now 5000 - for a fair start for the new system!

🔥 80 New Challenges

 Spread across all race tracks and game modes!
 20 old challenges have been replaced to keep things fresh.

🏆 First Steam Achievement!

 Karting Legend Trophy - “Platinum” style achievement for beating all challenges, and one of the hardest to earn!
 More achievements are coming soon, so stay tuned.

🎮 Keybind Customization

 You can now rebind the key that shows the player list during gameplay.


Note: This update is required for online play. Players on older versions will not be able to join rooms with the latest version.

Hope you will like it, the next update coming soon!

Quick Patch Notes - v1.0.2.51 (quickPatch1) 

Challenges

 Fixed challenges not being marked as complete after finishing.  
 Fixed issue when selected challenge was different from the one that was selected 
 Fixed issues with Cups in Challenges.  
 Challenge text fix from “Finish Race” to "Finish" in challenge info to support Battle Arenas.  

Gameplay Fixes & Tweaks

 Quick Cut Difficulty Fix– difficulty settings now correctly affect Quick Cut mode.  
 Battle Modes – all players now have **1 HP** for a more intense experience.  
 Teleport Dash – removed from Battle Arena for better balance.  
 Tank & Shield Power-ups – duration reduced from 30s to 20s.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.0.2.4 - New ELO Scoring & ELO Reset | 3 Tracks Fixed with Lead. Reset
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Sorry for the lack of updates over the past two weeks - I was away for a few days, but I’m back now, so you can expect regular updates again!

🏆 Major Update: New ELO Scoring System
I have created the new ELO scoring system to make ranked play fairer, more competitive, and more rewarding for both new and experienced players.

Key changes:

 Zero-sum foundation – Points are now gained by taking them from others. However, due to safeguards, the total won’t always add up to zero.
 Beginner-friendly protection - Low ELO players lose fewer points. For example, at 1500 ELO you’ll only take 10% of the normal loss (-50 becomes -5). This protection phases out by 4000 ELO.
 High-rank balancing - Above 6000 ELO, gains are slightly reduced. The absolute max achievable ELO should be around 8000–9000.
 Healthier distribution - Keeps rankings between ~1500–8000, while ensuring that the top 4 in a match generally gain points and the bottom 4 lose them.

📌Important: ELO Rank Reset

 ELO rankings have been reset due to the new scoring system.
 You’ll need to update your game to match with others on the latest Steam version.

Congrats to everyone who reached the top before the reset - I can’t wait to see how the new system shakes things up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43439860/1f05684ddfffa8db067e980e3ece6c445538a230.png

Note: With the smaller player base right now, match ELO ranges will be wide, but that will improve over time.


Track Fixes & Leaderboard Resets
Race Track Fixes:

 Scuba Driving – Added a collider to the rock before the shell.
 Pablo’s Jungle Jam – Fixed shortcut gate colliders so teleport dash works correctly.
📌Important: Leaderboard Resets + Fixes

 Beach Blast – Removed collider at border tops to prevent jumping off.
 Abandoned Roadway – Added rock colliders (WR exploit removed). Leaderboard reset.
 Sheriff’s Town Tour – Re-enabled ground respawn collider outside borders to stop out-of-bounds driving.

What’s Next?

 Working on 60+ new challenges for the next update - across all tracks and game modes. Some may be extra unique (no promises yet).
 Continuing to fix smaller bugs & improvements from the tk2.nolt.io roadmap.

After That
I’m working on a new matchmaking system to remove region barriers completely. The “search in background” feature has been removed in preparation for this.

On the Path to Overwhelmingly Positive
We’re at 532 reviews and over 94% positive right now, and I’m truly thankful for this amazing reception so far 🙏.

With this update (and the ones still to come), I hope we can eventually reach that magic 95% “Overwhelmingly Positive” rating. If you already love the game - or if future updates make you love it even more - consider leaving a review.

I’m confident we’ll get there sooner or later, because I’ve got some crazy things planned for the game… just need to tackle a lot of your current feedback first 😄

notes.title: Patch v1.0.0.2 - Online QuickMatch, Search in Background, ELO Fix, and more
notes.notes:
👋 Hey everyone,

🛠️ Thanks for Your Feedback!
First of all - huge thanks to everyone for reporting issues and sending suggestions! Every bit of feedback is read and appreciated. I originally planned to share the roadmap with a full priority list today, but this patch took a bit more time than expected. The roadmap is coming tomorrow, so stay tuned!

📝 Thanks for the Steam Reviews
Massive thanks to everyone who left a review on the Steam page 🙏 It really helps the game, and also keeps me sane during the long dev hours 😅 I appreciate every single one. 
If you haven’t reviewed the game yet and you’re enjoying it, consider spreading the word and leaving a review!

✅ Where are the new Challenges and Fixes?
I’ve already gathered a long list of both big and small improvements, and don’t worry - the next patch (v1.0.0.3) will focus exactly on that. What’s inside? You’ll find out in tomorrow’s roadmap! 

I know some of you were waiting for this update sooner, but I had to prioritize a major improvement to Online Play first to make sure the experience is solid for everyone. I hope you’ll agree it was the right call 🙏

🌐 About This Patch – v1.0.0.2 - IMPROVING ONLINE MATCHMAKING
I’ve seen quite a few posts saying it’s hard to find an online room sometimes. That’s why-even with a busy to-do list, I decided to make this my top priority.

The player base isn’t huge (yet!), but it’s strong and dedicated enough to build a great Time Trial, Casual, and Competitive Online scene. 

My goal is to take care of our community and make the best possible experience for you. Now’s the perfect moment to shape the future of the game and stay connected to a passionate, smaller (but growing) audience.

🎯 Patch – v1.0.0.2 

 📈 ELO point distribution reworked – should feel much better now
 🧠 Competitive ELO: from 5,000 it’s getting serious. Above 7,000 ELO it becomes a zero-sum game (like in chess)
 🎮 Quick Match added with game mode selection
 🌍 Public lobbies are ranked-only (no need to pick ranked/unranked)
 👥 Private races are unranked
 📢 Discord Room Notifications – if no room is found in your region and you start a new one, a Discord message will auto-send after 20 seconds to help others join
 🕹️ Search in Background – after 40 seconds solo, you can switch to background searching and go play something else (even single-player). You'll get notified when a match is found
 🔄 After 180 seconds with no room found in your selected mode, you may be offered to join another available mode (optional)



🧩 Next Patch – v1.0.0.3
Even though this update is focused on online play, I’m actively working on the rest of the issues you’ve reported.
Patch v1.0.0.3 will land early next week and include new Challenges and a ton of other improvements!

Thanks for your patience and support ❤️

Stay tuned for roadmap and Patch v1.0.0.3!

notes.title: Release Date Postponed | Public Playtest Registration Open
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you so much for being here — I can truly feel the excitement building around the game’s release and it means a lot! 💙

📢 I’ve got two updates to share — one good, and one not-so-good.

🛑 The Delay 
(But you’ll still get to play today with brand new game mode! 
Check the screen below to see a preview )
The tough news first: despite all the sleepless nights, countless hours, and the fact that all tracks, arenas, and game modes are in place — I can’t release the game just yet.

My original plan was to test the game with a small closed community group before launch. Unfortunately, I ended up building things right up to the last minute, and that testing phase didn’t happen. 

Even though the full scope of the game is almost complete, There still might be bugs, performance issues, and other problems — simply because I didn’t have time to properly test everything, optimize everything and test everything in online (with so many game modes it is just too risky).

This game promises to be the best kart racer on the market — and while this delay is disappointing, I’d rather push the release than risk breaking your trust. The game is massive, and without solid testing, your experience just wouldn’t be where it should be.

😞 I’m just as disappointed as you are. But the game’s future , and community around the game - matters more than pushing it out too soon and risking killing the game after all these years.

📆 So, When’s the New Date?
To make sure we do this properly, the new release date is July 17th. 

🎮 Free Playtest 
But Here’s the Good News - you’ll still get to play part of the game and with a brand new game mode and new track,
I know many of you were ready to play — so today/tomorrow, I will launch a public playtest!
Look for the next announcement later this day

You’ll get access to:
🚗 A brand-new track
🌐 Online multiplayer support
🔥 A fresh new game mode: Road Breaker

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43439860/3d136debb88d510551361ec1137032ee1fa070bf.png

This playtest will run all week, including the weekend — and there might even be a second one 👀

Even though the full launch is delayed, you’ll still get hands-on time with the game for free— and that might even be better for some of you. 
Be sure to invite your friends and ask them to wishlist the game too 🙌

🎉 Road Breaker is seriously fun — I hope, even if you’re disappointed, you’ll understand and support the decision ❤️ 

Edit - Playtest registration is now open, as soon as playtest begin I will let everyone knows!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date & Pricing Revealed!
notes.notes:
Release Date
After years of work, I’m super excited to finally share the big news: 
The Karters 2: Turbo Charged is coming to Early Access on June 2nd, 2025!

Yep, just a few weeks away—and yep, it’s the same week Mario Kart World drops. 
That means it’s going to be an epic week for all kart racing fans. 

And honestly? I believe our indie kart racer has the power to surprise a lot of people!
It’s time for the karting genre to shine 🏁

What can you expect at launch?

 🏎️ 16 unique race tracks
 🔥 6–8 battle arenas
 🎮 8–12 game modes – some for racing, some for battling, and some totally new like Quick Cut with semi-randomized tracks
 🌐 Online multiplayer with dedicated servers, clans, and ranked matches
 🛠️ Modding support with – over 1,000 mods already supported! 
 👉 Check out the Workshop here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2269950/workshop/

The Steam page will get updated soon with all the final details: modes, features, languages, and more

So why Early Access?
Originally, the plan was to do a full release. 
Now, as you may have noticed, I’ve decided to launch the game in Early Access. 
But don’t worry - all the game content will be there from day one - tracks, modes, multiplayer, modding.

Early Access just gives me space to add at least these two INSANE features: 
 A full Story Mode Campaign
An in-game track editor, so you can build and share tracks right inside the game. Modnation Racers style
Of course you can expect improvements, more content and more game modes through this EA phase as well!

Pricing
The Karters 2 will be priced at $29.99 during Early Access with regional pricing support and launch discount. 

I hope to include 4-pack bundle where you can get 4 copies in a price of 3 but Steam need to approve that first - so stay tuned for more updates about that.

The Goal - Full Release
The goal is to launch the full version by the end of 2025, simultaneously with Consoles, with modding, in-game track editor, story mode and online cross-play support on Consoles from day one.

Devlogs
Leading up to launch, I’ll be posting devlog updates almost daily - right here on Steam, in the Discord, and on X.

 discord.gg/TheKarters
 https://x.com/SebsGamedevVLOG

One of the X post got over 750 000 views and overall it is a great summary of the game so check it out: 
https://x.com/SebsGamedevVLOG/status/1911089844203184222

In-Depth Youtube Videos
Don’t forget to check out the latest videos on the official The Karters 2 YouTube channel! 
We dive deep into Time Trials, Modding, Items, and Physics - each video is around 10 minutes long and packed with details

https://www.youtube.com/@thekarters2/videos


Spread the word!
If you’re excited for The Karters 2, please share the news with your friends and communities. If you know content creators who love kart games, let them know too!

Thank you for joining this journey. Let’s make The Karters 2: Turbo Charged the kart racer you’ve dreamed of!
